questions.text: नेतृत्व की वह शैली जिसमें अधीनस्थ प्रबंधक द्वारा दिए गए निर्देशों के अनुसार कार्य करते हैं तथा संप्रेषण एक मार्गीय होता है, जानी जाती है :
questions.text_english: The leadership style in which subordinates act according to the command given by the manager and the communication is one way, is known as :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Autocratic leadership style. In autocratic leadership, the leader gives orders and subordinates are expected to follow them without question. Communication flows in one direction — from the top downward — and subordinates have no say in decision-making. Democratic leadership involves two-way communication and participation of subordinates. Free-rein leadership gives complete freedom to subordinates, making options B and C incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) एकतंत्रीय नेतृत्व शैली है। इस शैली में नेता आदेश देता है और अधीनस्थ बिना प्रश्न किए उसका पालन करते हैं। संप्रेषण केवल ऊपर से नीचे की ओर होता है। लोकतांत्रिक शैली में दो-तरफा संप्रेषण होता है और स्वतंत्र नेतृत्व शैली में अधीनस्थों को पूरी स्वतंत्रता दी जाती है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :
कथन I : नियम प्रबंधकीय निर्णयों को प्रतिबिंबित करते हैं कि अमुक कार्य निश्चित रूप से होना है अथवा नहीं होना है।
कथन II : नियम लचीलापन अथवा कार्य-स्वतंत्रता की अनुमति देते हैं।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :
Statement I : A rule reflects a managerial decision that a certain action must or must not be taken.
Statement II : A rule allows flexibility or discretion.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following :

options.A: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं।
options.B: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों असत्य हैं।
options.C: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.D: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.B: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
options_english.C: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.D: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Statement I is true and Statement II is false. Statement I is correct because a rule is a specific, definite plan that leaves no room for interpretation — it reflects a managerial decision about what must or must not be done. Statement II is false because rules, by definition, do not allow flexibility or discretion. Rules are rigid and must be strictly followed, unlike policies which provide some room for judgment.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है — कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है। नियम एक निश्चित योजना होती है जो स्पष्ट रूप से बताती है कि कोई कार्य होना चाहिए या नहीं। इसमें कोई लचीलापन नहीं होता। इसलिए कथन I सही है और कथन II गलत है।

questions.text: उपभोक्ताओं में जागरूकता बढ़ाने के लिए, सरकार एक अभियान 'जागो ग्राहक जागो' चला रही है। यह अभियान निम्नलिखित में से किस अधिकार का भाग है ?
questions.text_english: To promote awareness among consumers, the government is running a campaign 'Jago Grahak Jago'. This campaign is a part of which of the following right ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Right to consumer education. The 'Jago Grahak Jago' (Wake Up Consumer, Wake Up) campaign is run by the Government of India to educate consumers about their rights and responsibilities. This campaign falls under the Right to Consumer Education, which ensures that consumers have access to knowledge and skills needed to make informed choices. It is not about information on a specific product (Right to be informed), nor about safety of products or filing complaints.
questions.solution_hindi: 'जागो ग्राहक जागो' अभियान का उद्देश्य उपभोक्ताओं को उनके अधिकारों और जिम्मेदारियों के बारे में शिक्षित करना है। यह उपभोक्ता शिक्षा के अधिकार का भाग है जो उपभोक्ताओं को सूचित निर्णय लेने के लिए आवश्यक ज्ञान प्रदान करता है।
questions.topic: Consumer Rights — Right to Consumer Education

questions.text: वह अध्ययन जो किसी विशेष कार्य को करने के लिए की जाने वाली मुद्राओं के अध्ययन को संदर्भित करता है, कहलाता है :
questions.text_english: The study which refers to the study of movements which are undertaken while doing a typical job, is called :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Motion study. Motion study involves the study of the movements of the limbs of a worker while performing a job so that unnecessary movements can be eliminated. This helps in saving time and increases efficiency. Method study focuses on finding better ways to perform a job, time study measures the time taken to complete a task, and fatigue study analyses when and why a worker gets tired — none of these refers to the study of body movements specifically.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) गति अध्ययन है। गति अध्ययन में कार्य करते समय श्रमिक के शरीर के अंगों की गतिविधियों का अध्ययन किया जाता है ताकि अनावश्यक गतिविधियों को समाप्त किया जा सके और दक्षता बढ़ाई जा सके।

questions.text: कुछ पूर्व-निश्चित मानकों के संदर्भ में एक कर्मचारी की वर्तमान और/अथवा पूर्व निष्पादन का मूल्यांकन, जाना जाता है :
questions.text_english: Evaluating an employee's current and/or past performance as against certain pre-determined standards, is known as :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Performance appraisal. Performance appraisal is the systematic process of evaluating an employee's current and/or past work performance against pre-set standards. It is a staffing activity that helps in determining pay hikes, promotions, and training needs. Selection decision occurs during recruitment, compensation relates to pay and benefits, and preliminary screening is a step in the selection process — none of these involve evaluation against pre-determined standards.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) निष्पादन मूल्यांकन है। यह एक व्यवस्थित प्रक्रिया है जिसमें पूर्व-निर्धारित मानकों के आधार पर कर्मचारी के कार्य-निष्पादन का मूल्यांकन किया जाता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से शेयर बाज़ार का कौन-सा कार्य निवेशकर्ताओं को प्रतिभूतियों में विनिवेश तथा पुनर्निवेश का अवसर देता है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following functions of the Stock Exchange gives investors the chance to disinvest and re-invest in securities ?

options.C: विद्यमान प्रतिभूतियों को द्रवता एवं विनियोग (विक्रेयता) उपलब्ध कराना
options.D: सट्टेबाजी के लिए अवसर प्रदान करना

options_english.C: Providing liquidity and marketability to existing securities

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Providing liquidity and marketability to existing securities. The stock exchange provides a ready market where already-issued securities can be bought and sold at any time. This gives investors the chance to disinvest (sell their existing holdings) and re-invest (buy new securities) easily. Pricing of securities involves price discovery, safety of transactions ensures investor security, and speculation is a different activity altogether — none of these specifically enable disinvestment and reinvestment.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। शेयर बाज़ार विद्यमान प्रतिभूतियों को तरलता और विपणन योग्यता प्रदान करता है जिससे निवेशक किसी भी समय अपनी प्रतिभूतियाँ बेच सकते हैं (विनिवेश) और नई प्रतिभूतियाँ खरीद सकते हैं (पुनर्निवेश)।

questions.text:
एक अग्रणी समाचार-पत्र कंपनी ने अपने बाज़ार अंश को 10% बढ़ाने का निर्णय लिया। कुछ आधारभूत धारणाओं को विकसित करने के बाद, कंपनी ने निम्नलिखित वैकल्पिक कार्यविधियों की पहचान की :
(i) समाचार-पत्र पर्यावरण के अनुकूल हों।
(ii) बच्चों के लिए विशेष विभागों को समाविष्ट किया जाए।
(iii) प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं के लिए सामान्य ज्ञान को बढ़ावा देने के लिए कुछ कॉलम हों।
(iv) दैनिक आधार पर अंतरराष्ट्रीय समाचार हों।
उपर्युक्त विकल्पों की पहचान के बाद, एक बोर्ड मीटिंग बुलाई गई। निम्नलिखित में से नियोजन प्रक्रिया के अगले चरण की पहचान कीजिए जिसे बोर्ड मीटिंग में लिया जाना है।
questions.text_english:
A leading newspaper company decided to increase its market share by 10%. After developing the premises, the company identified the following alternative courses of action to be adopted :
(i) To have eco-friendly newspapers
(ii) To introduce specific sections for children
(iii) To have columns for increasing general awareness for competitive exams
(iv) To have international news on a daily basis
After identifying the above alternatives, a board meeting was called. Identify from the following, the next step in the planning process which is to be taken in the board meeting.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Evaluating alternative courses. The planning process follows a sequence: Setting objectives → Developing premises → Identifying alternatives → Evaluating alternatives → Selecting the best alternative → Implementing the plan → Follow-up. In the question, the company has already identified the alternatives (step 4). The next logical step is to evaluate these alternatives (step 5) in terms of feasibility, cost, and effectiveness before choosing one. Selecting an alternative comes only after evaluation, and implementing and follow-up are later steps.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) विकल्पों का मूल्यांकन करना है। नियोजन प्रक्रिया में वैकल्पिक कार्यक्रमों की पहचान के बाद अगला चरण उनका मूल्यांकन करना होता है। विकल्प का चयन उसके बाद होता है।

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए चित्र से अपने संप्रेषण उद्देश्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए संगठन द्वारा प्रयोग में लाए गए प्रवर्तन साधन/तकनीक को पहचानिए :
questions.text_english: From the picture given below identify the promotional tool used by the organisation to achieve its communication objectives :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Sales Promotion. The image shows a chocolate bar packet with '10% Extra' printed on it. Offering extra quantity at the same price is a classic sales promotion technique used to attract customers and boost short-term sales. Advertising uses mass media like TV and newspapers, personal selling involves direct one-to-one selling, and public relations involves building a positive image — none of these match the '10% Extra' offer shown on the packaging.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) विक्रय संवर्धन है। चित्र में चॉकलेट पैकेट पर '10% अतिरिक्त' का ऑफर दिखाया गया है जो एक विक्रय संवर्धन तकनीक है। यह ग्राहकों को अल्पकाल में अधिक खरीदने के लिए प्रेरित करती है।

questions.text: 'स्टॉक एक्सचेंज एवं मध्यस्थों के निरीक्षण द्वारा, पूछताछ तथा अंकेक्षण द्वारा सूचना माँगना' भारतीय प्रतिभूति एवं विनिमय बोर्ड का _______ है।
questions.text_english: 'Calling for information by undertaking inspection, conducting enquiries and audits of stock exchanges and intermediaries' is _______ of Securities and Exchange Board of India.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Regulatory Function. SEBI performs this function as part of its regulatory role to maintain discipline and order in the securities market. Conducting inspections, enquiries, and audits of stock exchanges and intermediaries is a regulatory activity aimed at checking compliance with rules and regulations. Development functions involve promoting the market and educating investors, while protective functions involve protecting investor interests — calling for information through audits specifically qualifies as a regulatory function.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) नियमनकर्ता कार्य है। SEBI स्टॉक एक्सचेंज और मध्यस्थों का निरीक्षण, पूछताछ और अंकेक्षण अपने नियामक कार्य के अंतर्गत करता है ताकि नियमों का पालन सुनिश्चित हो।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :
कथन I : इलेक्ट्रिकल उपकरणों को खरीदते समय, उपभोक्ता केवल ISI मार्क उत्पादों को ही खरीदें।
कथन II : यह उपभोक्ता का उत्तरदायित्व है कि वह केवल मानकीकृत वस्तुएँ ही खरीदें क्योंकि ये गुणवत्ता का आश्वासन प्रदान करती हैं।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :
Statement I : While buying electrical appliances, a consumer should buy only ISI mark products.
Statement II : It is the responsibility of a consumer to buy only standardised goods as they provide quality assurance.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।
options.C: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं।
options.D: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों असत्य हैं।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.
options_english.C: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Both Statement I and Statement II are true. Statement I is correct — consumers should prefer ISI-marked electrical products as the ISI mark certifies that the product meets national safety and quality standards set by the Bureau of Indian Standards. Statement II is also correct — it is a consumer's responsibility to purchase only standardised goods because such goods guarantee quality. Both statements thus highlight the importance of buying standardised and certified products for safety and quality assurance.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। ISI मार्क उत्पाद राष्ट्रीय मानकों के अनुरूप होते हैं और उपभोक्ता का उत्तरदायित्व है कि वह मानकीकृत वस्तुएँ ही खरीदे। दोनों कथन उपभोक्ता के उत्तरदायित्व और सुरक्षा की दृष्टि से सही हैं।

questions.text:
कॉलम-II में दिए गए उत्पादन कार्य-प्रभारी के कार्यों का कॉलम-I में दिए गए उनके नामों के साथ मिलान कीजिए।
कॉलम-I: 1. गति नायक, 2. टोली नायक, 3. मरम्मत नायक, 4. निरीक्षक
कॉलम-II: (i) मशीनों एवं औज़ारों की उचित कार्य दशाओं को आश्वस्त करना, (ii) कार्य की गुणवत्ता की जाँच करना, (iii) मशीनों एवं औज़ारों, इत्यादि को कर्मचारियों के प्रचालन के लिए तैयार रखना, (iv) कार्य को समयानुसार एवं सही ढंग से पूरा करने के लिए आश्वस्त करना
questions.text_english:
Match the following functions of Production In-charges stated in Column-II with their names in Column-I.
Column-I: 1. Speed Boss, 2. Gang Boss, 3. Repair Boss, 4. Inspector
Column-II: (i) To ensure proper working conditions of machines and tools, (ii) To check the quality of work, (iii) To keep machines and tools, etc. ready for operation by workers, (iv) To ensure timely and accurate completion of job
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) 1-(iv), 2-(iii), 3-(i), 4-(ii). Speed Boss (गति नायक) ensures timely and accurate completion of the job (iv). Gang Boss (टोली नायक) keeps machines and tools ready for the workers to operate (iii). Repair Boss (मरम्मत नायक) ensures proper working conditions of machines and tools (i). Inspector (निरीक्षक) checks the quality of work performed (ii). This matching is based on Taylor's concept of functional foremanship under Scientific Management.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। गति नायक — (iv) कार्य को समयानुसार पूरा करना; टोली नायक — (iii) मशीनें तैयार रखना; मरम्मत नायक — (i) मशीनों की कार्य दशाओं को सुनिश्चित करना; निरीक्षक — (ii) कार्य की गुणवत्ता जाँचना।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए : अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R)।
अभिकथन (A) : अधिकार का प्रवाह उच्च अधिकारी से अधीनस्थ की ओर नीचे की ओर होता है।
कारण (R) : अधिकार से अभिप्राय एक व्यक्ति के उस अधिकार से है जिसके आधार पर वह अपने अधीनस्थों को आदेश देता है और अपने पद-क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत कार्यवाही करता है।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements : Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A) : Authority flows downwards from superior to subordinate.
Reason (R) : Authority is the right of an individual to command the subordinates and to take action within the scope of his position.
Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A). Assertion (A) is true — authority indeed flows downward from superior to subordinate in the scalar chain of an organisation. Reason (R) is also true — authority is defined as the right to give orders and take action. However, the Reason does not explain why authority flows downward. The downward flow of authority is explained by the scalar chain principle, not merely by the definition of authority. Hence, both are true but R does not correctly explain A.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। अभिकथन (A) सत्य है कि अधिकार ऊपर से नीचे की ओर प्रवाहित होता है। कारण (R) भी सत्य है — अधिकार का अर्थ अधीनस्थों को आदेश देने का अधिकार है। किन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है क्योंकि यह मात्र परिभाषा है, कारण नहीं।

questions.text: 'होमली स्पेस' घर की सजावट करने वाली एक कंपनी है जो घर संबंधी सभी आंतरिक अभिकल्पन (डिजाइन) के लिए सेवाएँ प्रदान करती हैं। कंपनी में निरंतर सभाओं, सुझाव पेटी, शिकायत पेटी, सामाजिक एवं सांस्कृतिक जनसमूह, आदि जैसी सुविधाओं की कमी है। उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति में इस कारण बाधाएँ उत्पन्न होती हैं। निम्नलिखित में से उस संप्रेषण बाधा को पहचानिए जिसकी चर्चा उपर्युक्त में की गई है :
questions.text_english: 'Homely Space' is a home decor company providing interior design services. The company lacks facilities like frequent meetings, suggestion box, complaint box, social and cultural gatherings, etc. This causes hindrance in achieving the objectives. Identify the type of communication barrier discussed above from the following :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Organisational barrier. The lack of structural provisions like suggestion boxes, complaint boxes, meetings, and social gatherings in an organisation creates organisational barriers to communication. These are barriers that arise from the structure or policies of the organisation itself, such as absence of formal channels and facilities for communication. Semantic barriers relate to language and meaning, psychological barriers involve emotions and attitudes, and personal barriers are individual limitations — none of these match the structural deficiencies described.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) संगठनिक बाधा है। सुझाव पेटी, शिकायत पेटी, सभाओं जैसी सुविधाओं का अभाव संगठनात्मक संरचना से संबंधित बाधाएँ हैं जो संप्रेषण में रुकावट डालती हैं।

questions.text: मैनन को जो 'सुपीरियर टॉयज कंपनी' में एक कर्मचारी है, उसके उच्च अधिकारी द्वारा एक सप्ताह में 100 खिलौने उत्पादित करने का कार्य दिया गया। मैनन ने अपने अधीनस्थों रोहन एवं फरहान को इस कार्य का अंतरण कर दिया। फरहान दुर्घटनाग्रस्त हो गया और उसे अस्पताल में भर्ती किया गया। रोहन स्वयं को आबंटित घंटों से अधिक घंटे काम करने के बाद भी इस कार्य को पूरा नहीं कर सका। इस कार्य के लिए मैनन के उच्च अधिकारी के प्रति कौन जवाबदेह है ?
questions.text_english: Menon, a worker in 'Superior Toys Company' was given a task by his superior to produce 100 toys in a week. Menon delegated this task to his subordinates, Rohan and Farhan. Farhan met with an accident and was hospitalised. Rohan could not complete this task even after working more hours than allotted. Who is answerable to Menon's superior for this task ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Menon. This question is based on the principle that 'authority can be delegated but responsibility cannot be delegated.' Menon was originally given the task by his superior and is therefore ultimately accountable for its completion. Even though Menon delegated the task to Rohan and Farhan, the accountability for the task still rests with Menon before his superior. Delegation transfers authority, not accountability. Hence, Menon alone remains answerable to his superior.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) मैनन है। प्रत्यायोजन के सिद्धांत के अनुसार 'अधिकार का प्रत्यायोजन किया जा सकता है परन्तु उत्तरदायित्व का नहीं।' मैनन अपने उच्च अधिकारी को कार्य पूरा करने के लिए जवाबदेह रहेगा।

questions.text: राधिका के पास 'तारा लिमिटेड' के 20,000 अंश हैं जिन्हें वह बेचना चाहती है। निम्नलिखित में से किस बाज़ार में वह इन अंशों को बेच सकती है ?
questions.text_english: Radhika wants to sell 20,000 shares of 'Tara Ltd.' held by her. In which of the following market can she sell these shares ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Secondary Market. The secondary market (stock exchange) is the market where already issued securities are bought and sold. Radhika already holds 20,000 shares that were previously issued by Tara Ltd. She can sell them in the secondary market (stock exchange) to other investors. The primary market deals with new issues of securities by companies, the money market deals with short-term instruments, and since neither primary market nor money market allow trading of existing shares, option D is also incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) द्वितीयक बाज़ार है। राधिका के पास पहले से जारी अंश हैं। ऐसे अंशों का क्रय-विक्रय द्वितीयक बाज़ार (शेयर बाज़ार) में होता है। प्राथमिक बाज़ार में नई प्रतिभूतियाँ जारी होती हैं।

questions.text:
'टीए लिमिटेड' ने बारह अभ्यर्थियों के आवेदन उनके द्वारा आवेदन-पत्रों में प्रदान की गई सूचना के आधार पर रद्द कर दिए। इन अभ्यर्थियों के पास पाँच वर्ष का अनुभव तथा वित्त में व्यवसाय प्रशासन में स्नातकोत्तर (एमबीए) की डिग्री नहीं थी, जो दोनों वित्त प्रबंधक के पद के लिए पूर्व-अपेक्षित थे।
निम्नलिखित में से 'चयन प्रक्रिया' के उस चरण की पहचान कीजिए जिसकी चर्चा उपर्युक्त स्थिति में की गई है।
questions.text_english:
'TA Ltd.' rejected the applications of twelve candidates based on the information supplied by them in their application forms. These candidates did not have the required five years of experience and the Masters in Business Administration (MBA) degree in Finance, both of which were pre-requisites for the post of Finance Manager.
From the following, identify the step of 'Selection Process' discussed in the above case.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Preliminary Screening. Preliminary screening is the first step in the selection process in which applications are screened to check whether applicants meet the basic job requirements. In this case, TA Ltd. is rejecting candidates who do not meet the minimum criteria (5 years experience and MBA in Finance) based on their application forms. This is precisely what preliminary screening involves — filtering out ineligible applicants at the outset before proceeding to tests or interviews.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) प्रारंभिक जाँच है। आवेदन-पत्रों की जानकारी के आधार पर अयोग्य उम्मीदवारों को हटाना प्रारंभिक जाँच का कार्य है। इसमें देखा जाता है कि उम्मीदवार न्यूनतम योग्यता की शर्तें पूरी करता है या नहीं।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए : अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R)।
अभिकथन (A) : एक अच्छी नियंत्रण प्रणाली कर्मचारियों को अभिप्रेरित करती है और बेहतर कार्य-निष्पादन में उनकी सहायता करती है।
कारण (R) : यह सुनिश्चित करती है कि कर्मचारियों को पहले से ही ज्ञात होता है कि उनके कार्य-निष्पादन के क्या मानक हैं जिनके आधार पर उनकी समीक्षा होगी।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements : Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A) : A good control system motivates employees and helps them to give better performance.
Reason (R) : It ensures that employees know well in advance what they are expected to do and what the standards of performance are, on the basis of which they will be appraised.
Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.B: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
options_english.C: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.D: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A). A good control system indeed motivates employees (Assertion A is true). The reason this happens is that when employees know in advance the standards against which they will be evaluated, they have clear targets to work towards, which motivates them to perform better. Reason (R) correctly explains why Assertion (A) is true — prior knowledge of performance standards removes ambiguity and motivates employees.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। एक अच्छी नियंत्रण प्रणाली कर्मचारियों को अभिप्रेरित करती है (अभिकथन A सत्य है) क्योंकि उन्हें पहले से पता होता है कि किस मानक पर उनकी समीक्षा होगी और वे उसी अनुसार कार्य करते हैं (कारण R सही व्याख्या है)।

questions.text:
'ध्रुव लिमिटेड' को विभिन्न राज्यों में अपनी वस्तुओं का परिवहन करने के लिए नियमित आधार पर दो ड्राइवरों की आवश्यकता है। इन ड्राइवरों के पदों को भरने के लिए, कंपनी ने निर्णय लिया कि यह सूचना कंपनी के मुख्य द्वार के पास नोटिस बोर्ड पर लगा दी जाए जिसमें इच्छुक लोगों को एक विशेष तिथि एवं समय पर प्रबंधक से मिलने के लिए कहा जाए।
निम्नलिखित में से ड्राइवरों के पदों को भरने के लिए 'ध्रुव लिमिटेड' द्वारा प्रयुक्त भर्ती के स्रोत को पहचानिए :
questions.text_english:
'Dhruv Ltd.' is in need of two drivers on regular basis to transport the goods to different states. To fill the post of drivers, the company decides to put the information on the Notice Board, placed near the main gate of the company, asking interested persons to meet the manager on a particular date and time.
From the following, identify the source of recruitment used by 'Dhruv Ltd.' for filling the post of drivers :

options.B: आकस्मिक रूप से बुलाए जाने वाले (प्रतीक्षा सूची)

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Direct Recruitment. Direct recruitment (also called factory gate recruitment) involves placing a notice at the gate of the organisation inviting interested candidates to apply or appear in person. This is exactly what Dhruv Ltd. is doing — posting information on the notice board near the main gate asking interested persons to meet the manager on a specified date. Campus recruitment involves hiring from colleges, casual callers are unsolicited applicants, and advertisement is through media like newspapers — none of these match this scenario.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) प्रत्यक्ष भर्ती है। कंपनी के मुख्य द्वार के पास नोटिस बोर्ड पर सूचना लगाकर इच्छुक व्यक्तियों को सीधे आमंत्रित करना प्रत्यक्ष भर्ती का उदाहरण है।

questions.text: 'एक खराब टेलीफोन कनेक्शन' निम्नलिखित में से संप्रेषण प्रक्रिया के किस तत्त्व का उदाहरण है ?
questions.text_english: 'A poor telephone connection' is an example of which of the following element of communication process ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Noise. In the communication process, 'noise' refers to any interference or barrier that distorts the message being transmitted. A poor telephone connection creates distortion in the transmitted signal, thereby interfering with the clear transmission of the message — this is a classic example of noise. Message is the content being communicated, media is the channel used, and decoding is the receiver's interpretation of the message. None of these involve distortion during transmission.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) ध्वनि (Noise) है। संप्रेषण प्रक्रिया में 'ध्वनि' वह हस्तक्षेप है जो संदेश को विकृत करती है। खराब टेलीफोन कनेक्शन संचरण में बाधा डालता है जो ध्वनि (noise) का उदाहरण है।

questions.text: 'केजे लिमिटेड' उदयपुर में एक टाइल निर्माता कंपनी है और राजस्थान के विभिन्न शहरों में इसके अपने स्टोर्स हैं। अपने विभिन्न स्टोरों में टाइल्स को भिजवाने के लिए अपने ट्रकों को खरीदने की अपेक्षा कंपनी ने ट्रकों को पट्टे पर उपयोग करने का निर्णय लिया। पहचानिए कि ट्रकों को पट्टे पर लेने का निर्णय किस प्रकार कंपनी की पूँजी आवश्यकताओं को प्रभावित करेगा।
questions.text_english: 'KJ Ltd.' is a tile manufacturing company in Udaipur having its own stores in various cities of Rajasthan. Instead of having its own trucks, the company decides to use trucks on lease to transport its tiles to various stores. Identify how the company's decision to lease trucks will affect its capital requirements.

options.A: स्थायी पूँजी की आवश्यकताओं को कम करेगा
options.B: स्थायी पूँजी की आवश्यकताओं में वृद्धि करेगा
options.C: स्थायी पूँजी की आवश्यकताओं को प्रभावित नहीं करेगा
options.D: कार्यशील पूँजी की आवश्यकताओं में कमी करेगा

options_english.C: Will not affect the fixed capital requirements

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Decrease the fixed capital requirements. Fixed capital is required to purchase long-term assets like machinery, buildings, and vehicles. When a company decides to lease trucks instead of purchasing them, it does not need to invest a large sum in buying these vehicles. This reduces the need for fixed capital. Leasing involves periodic rental payments (affecting working capital slightly) but significantly reduces the upfront fixed capital investment. Hence, leasing trucks decreases fixed capital requirements.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। ट्रकों को पट्टे पर लेने से कंपनी को ट्रक खरीदने के लिए बड़ी पूँजी नहीं लगानी पड़ती। इससे स्थायी पूँजी की आवश्यकता कम हो जाती है।

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following functions of Marketing :
(i) Marketing planning
(ii) Customer support services

key_points: Marketing planning involves developing a comprehensive plan for the marketing of products or services to achieve organizational goals.
Customer support services involve after-sales services provided to customers to maintain satisfaction and loyalty.

sub_questions.solution: Marketing planning refers to the process of developing a comprehensive plan that outlines the marketing strategies, goals, and activities required to achieve the desired market share and revenue targets. It involves analysing the market, identifying target customers, and deciding on the appropriate marketing mix. Customer support services refer to the after-sales services provided by a company to its customers to ensure satisfaction even after the product is purchased. This includes installation, maintenance, complaint handling, and product servicing. Both functions are essential for building long-term customer relationships and sustaining competitive advantage.

sub_questions.text_english:
Differentiate between 'Marketing concept' and 'Selling concept' of marketing management philosophies on the basis of the following :
(i) Meaning
(ii) Main Focus
(iii) Means

key_points: Marketing concept focuses on identifying and satisfying customer needs profitably; Selling concept focuses on selling whatever is produced.
Main focus of Marketing concept is customer satisfaction; Selling concept focuses on the product and its sale.
Means: Marketing concept uses integrated marketing; Selling concept uses aggressive selling and promotion.

sub_questions.solution: The Marketing concept and Selling concept differ on three bases. Regarding meaning, the Marketing concept holds that a firm should produce what customers need, whereas the Selling concept believes that customers must be persuaded to buy whatever is produced. Regarding main focus, the Marketing concept focuses on customer satisfaction and long-term profits, while the Selling concept focuses on maximising sales volume of existing products. Regarding means, the Marketing concept employs an integrated marketing approach involving the entire marketing mix, whereas the Selling concept relies mainly on aggressive selling and promotional techniques to push products onto consumers.

questions.solution: This is an either/or question. Answer sub-part (a) OR sub-part (b).

questions.text:
समीर एक थोक विक्रेता है, जो क्रिकेट उपकरणों में लेन-देन करता है। वह विभिन्न निर्माताओं से बैट, बॉल, हेलमेट, दस्ताने, स्टंप, आदि जैसे क्रिकेट उपकरणों को खरीदता है और उपभोक्ताओं की सुविधा के लिए एक किट (थैला) में उन्हें एकत्रित करता है। उसने एक दिन में 100 किट एकत्रित करने का मानक लक्ष्य तय किया। माह के प्रथम सप्ताह में कर्मचारियों ने एक दिन में 92 – 96 किट एकत्रित किए, जो निश्चित मानकों से कम थे। जाँच करने पर यह पाया गया कि किट के एकत्रीकरण में यह विचलन हेलमेट की अनियमित आपूर्ति के कारण था। किट को एकत्रित करने के लिए कर्मचारियों को हेलमेट के लिए इंतजार करना पड़ता था।
(i) उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित प्रबंध के कार्य का उल्लेख कीजिए।
(ii) उपर्युक्त (i) में पहचाने गए कार्य के जिन चरणों की चर्चा उपर्युक्त अनुच्छेद में की गई है, उनका उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
Sameer is a wholesaler, who deals in cricket equipment. He collects cricket equipment like bats, balls, helmets, gloves, stumps, etc. from different manufacturers and assembles them in a kit for the convenience of customers. He sets a standard target to assemble 100 kits a day. During the first week of the month the workers assembled 92 – 96 kits a day, which was lower than the set standard. On investigation, it was found that the variation in assembly of kits was due to an irregular supply of helmets. Workers had to wait for helmets to assemble the kits.
(i) State the function of management discussed in the above case.
(ii) State the steps of the function identified in (i) above, which are discussed in the above paragraph.

key_points: (i) The function discussed is Controlling.

(ii) Steps: Setting standards (100 kits per day), Measuring actual performance (92-96 kits per day), Comparing performance with standards (identifying a shortfall), Analysing deviations (finding the cause — irregular supply of helmets).

questions.solution: The function of management discussed in the above case is Controlling. The steps of the controlling function discussed in the paragraph are as follows. First, setting standards — Sameer established a standard target of assembling 100 kits per day. Second, measuring actual performance — workers assembled only 92 to 96 kits per day during the first week. Third, comparing actual performance with standards — on comparison, it was found that actual output was lower than the set standard of 100 kits. Fourth, analysing deviations — on investigation, the reason for the deviation was identified as the irregular supply of helmets, which caused workers to wait.

questions.text_english:
Abhinav is working as a production manager in a steel manufacturing plant, 'KPG Ltd.' To compete in the market, he thought of replacing the existing machinery with new high-tech machinery. Abhinav discussed his idea with the Chief Executive Officer who asked him to prepare a proposal for the same and sent it to the finance manager. The finance manager said that this decision had to be evaluated carefully as it involved a huge amount of investment and was irreversible except at a huge cost.
Identify the decision which the finance manager would like to evaluate. State any two factors which may affect this decision.

key_points: The decision is a Capital Budgeting / Fixed Capital Investment decision.
Factor 1: Nature of business — the type and scale of operations determines the level of fixed capital needed.
Factor 2: Availability of funds — the company's ability to raise large-scale investment through equity or debt.

questions.solution: The decision which the finance manager would like to evaluate is the Capital Budgeting decision (also called fixed capital investment decision), as it involves investing a large amount in purchasing new high-tech machinery which is long-term, large-scale, and largely irreversible. Two factors that may affect this decision are: first, the nature and scale of business — a large-scale steel manufacturing plant requires heavy capital investment in advanced machinery to remain competitive; second, the cost of funds and availability of finance — since the investment is huge, the company must evaluate whether it can raise the required funds at an affordable cost through debt or equity without straining its financial position.

sub_questions.text_english: State any three points of importance of consumer protection from the point of view of business.

key_points: Long-term business interests: Consumer protection helps businesses build goodwill and ensures long-term sustainability.
Social responsibility: Businesses have a moral obligation to serve consumers honestly and ethically.
Legal compliance: Businesses must comply with consumer protection laws to avoid penalties and legal action.

sub_questions.solution: Consumer protection is important from the point of view of business for the following three reasons. First, it serves the long-term interest of business — a business that genuinely protects consumers builds trust and goodwill, leading to repeat purchases and sustained growth. Second, it fulfils social responsibility — businesses are a part of society and have an obligation to sell safe, quality products at fair prices without exploiting customers. Third, it ensures legal compliance — the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 imposes strict obligations on businesses, and protecting consumers helps businesses avoid fines, penalties, and damage to reputation.

key_points: Three tiers: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (District Commission), State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (State Commission), National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (National Commission).

Regarding their jurisdiction: the District Commission handles cases where the value of goods or services and compensation claimed does not exceed ₹1 crore. questions.text_english:
Rahul, the Managing Director of 'HariHar Ltd.' and Sahil, the finance manager were discussing about avenues of investing the idle funds of the company. Rahul was of the opinion that money should be invested in the capital market whereas Sahil felt that it would be better if the investment was made in the money market.
Explain with the help of any two points, giving reasons, why Sahil felt that investment in the money market is better.

key_points: Safety: Money market instruments are highly safe as they are short-term and issued by creditworthy institutions.
Liquidity: Money market instruments can be easily converted into cash, making them more liquid than capital market instruments.
Short-term tenure: Suits investment of idle/temporary funds as maturity periods are short (up to 1 year).
Low risk: Compared to the capital market, money market instruments carry lower risk of default.

questions.solution: Sahil felt that investing the idle funds in the money market is better than the capital market for two main reasons. First, safety and liquidity — money market instruments such as Treasury Bills, Commercial Papers, and Certificates of Deposit are highly liquid and relatively safe because they are short-term in nature and issued by creditworthy institutions like the government and large corporations. Idle funds of a company may be needed at short notice, and the money market allows quick conversion back to cash without significant loss of value. Second, lower risk — the capital market involves equity shares and long-term debt instruments that carry higher risk due to price volatility and longer lock-in periods. Since the funds are idle (not permanently surplus), it is prudent to invest them where risk is minimal and retrieval is quick, which makes the money market a safer and more appropriate choice.

'अमार्या डेयरी प्रोडक्ट्स' एक शानदार ब्रांड है जो बढ़िया गुणवत्ता वाले डेयरी उत्पादों की पेशकश करता है। यह न केवल अपने उत्पादों की गुणवत्ता के लिए प्रसिद्ध है, अपितु अपने कर्मचारियों को सेवानिवृत्ति तक संगठन में बनाए रखने के लिए भी प्रसिद्ध है। यह अपने कर्मचारियों को समय-समय पर सीखने के सुअवसर प्रदान कर उनके विकास में विश्वास रखती है। इसके लिए कंपनी ने अपने कर्मचारियों को दो समूहों में बाँटा है, समूह-I तथा समूह-II। समूह-I में 10 वर्ष या इससे अधिक अनुभव वाले कर्मारी हैं तथा समूह-II में वे कर्मचारी हैं जो अभी एक वर्ष पहले ही संगठन से जुड़े हैं।
समूह-II के कर्मचारियों को कंपनी द्वारा प्रदान किए जाने वाले सीखने के सुअवसर एक विशिष्ट कार्य को करने के लिए उनके कौशल, दृष्टिकोण एवं योग्यताओं की वृद्धि में सहायता करेंगे, जबकि समूह-I के कर्मचारियों को प्रदान किए जाने वाले सीखने के सुअवसर उन्हें सभी दृष्टिकोणों से विकास में सहायता करेंगे।
उपर्युक्त में चर्चित प्रबंध के नियुक्तिकरण कार्य की दो अवधारणाओं को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english:
'Amarya Dairy Products' is a fantastic brand offering great quality dairy products. It is not only famous for the quality of its products, but also for retaining its employees in the organisation till their retirement. It believes in growth of its employees by providing them learning opportunities from time to time. For this the company divided the employees in two groups, Group-I and Group-II. Group-I having employees experience of more than 10 years and Group-II have employees who had joined the organisation just one year before.
The learning opportunities provided by the company to Group-II employees would help them in increasing their skills, attitudes and abilities to perform specific jobs, whereas the learning opportunities provided to Group-I employees would help them to grow in all respects.
Identify and explain the two concepts of staffing function of management discussed above.

key_points: Group-II — Training: improving skills, attitudes, abilities for a specific job.
Group-I — Development: overall growth of the individual in all dimensions.

questions.solution: The two concepts of the staffing function discussed are Training and Development. Training refers to the process of increasing the knowledge, skills, and abilities of employees to perform specific jobs effectively. In the case of Group-II employees, the learning opportunities are designed to help them improve their skills, attitudes, and competencies required for their particular role in the dairy company. Development, on the other hand, is a broader concept that refers to the overall growth of an individual in all respects — intellectually, emotionally, and professionally. For Group-I employees who have more than 10 years of experience, the learning opportunities are aimed at developing them holistically so they can take on greater responsibilities and grow as well-rounded professionals. While training is job-specific and short-term, development is a continuous, long-term process focused on the complete growth of the employee.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following principles of 'Scientific Management' :
(i) Science not rule of thumb
(ii) Development of each and every person to his/her greatest efficiency and prosperity

key_points: Science not rule of thumb: decisions should be based on scientific study and research, not on guess or tradition.
Development of each person: management should train and develop every worker to his fullest potential for the benefit of both the worker and the organisation.

sub_questions.solution: Science not rule of thumb means that Taylor insisted on replacing traditional, unscientific methods of working (rule of thumb) with scientifically determined methods. Managers should use scientific research, observation, and analysis to find the one best way of performing every task, rather than relying on guesswork or past habits. For example, the exact weight to be lifted, the speed of movement, and the technique to be used should all be scientifically determined. Development of each and every person to his greatest efficiency and prosperity means that Taylor believed it is the responsibility of management to select the right person for the right job, provide proper training, and create conditions for maximum efficiency. When each worker is developed to his full potential, it leads to higher productivity, greater wages for the worker, and greater profits for the organisation — ensuring prosperity for both.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following principles of 'General Management' :
(i) Centralisation and Decentralisation
(ii) Division of work

key_points: Centralisation: concentration of authority at the top level; Decentralisation: dispersal of authority to lower levels.
Division of work: work should be divided into small tasks and each person should specialize in a particular task to increase efficiency.

sub_questions.solution: Centralisation and Decentralisation — Centralisation refers to the concentration of decision-making authority at the top levels of management. Decentralisation refers to the dispersal of authority to middle and lower levels. Fayol stated that the degree of centralisation or decentralisation depends on the size of the organisation, the nature of activities, and the capabilities of employees. No organisation can be completely centralised or completely decentralised; a balance between the two must be maintained for effective functioning. Division of work — This principle states that work should be divided into small, specialised tasks and assigned to individuals according to their expertise. When each person repeatedly performs a specific task, they develop speed, accuracy, and efficiency. For example, in an assembly line, different workers perform different operations. This leads to specialisation, reduces wastage of effort, and enhances overall organisational productivity.

(iii) अतिशा ने एक घर खरीदा और इसके लिए उसने बैंक से ऋण लिया। बैंक द्वारा ऋणों पर ब्याज दर बढ़ाने के कारण उसके ऋण की मासिक किश्त में वृद्धि हो गई।

questions.text_english:
Identify and explain the dimension of business environment in each of the following situations :
(i) 'Alexa pay my electricity bill' is the latest feature of Alexa App which enables Amazon customers to pay their utility bills with 'Amazon Pay' just by speaking to Alexa.
(ii) Monika is working in a multi-national company. As an impact of work-from-home regime, she is now in a better position to inculcate moral values and healthy food habits in her children.
(iii) Atisha purchased a home and for this she took a loan from the bank. Monthly instalment on her loan increased as the banks increased the interest rate on loans.
(iv) 'Mother's milk is best for babies' is printed on the pack of 'First Bite' baby milk powder, produced by 'MQP Baby Food Ltd.' By doing this, the company is not only protecting the consumers' interests, but also necessarily informing its potential buyers about the importance of mother's milk.

key_points: (i) Technological environment — use of AI (Alexa) and digital payments (Amazon Pay) represents technological advancements.
(ii) Social environment — shift in social values and lifestyle patterns due to work-from-home affecting family and moral values.
(iii) Economic environment — change in interest rates by banks affects borrowing costs and consumers' financial commitments.
(iv) Legal environment — the company is complying with legal requirements to inform consumers about product limitations, reflecting legal/regulatory obligations.

questions.solution: The dimensions of business environment in each situation are as follows. Situation (i) represents the Technological environment — the Alexa app's voice-activated bill payment feature through Amazon Pay is an example of how advancements in technology (artificial intelligence and digital payment systems) are changing the way businesses operate and serve customers. Situation (ii) represents the Social environment — the work-from-home trend has changed social lifestyles and family dynamics. Monika being able to inculcate moral values and healthy habits in her children reflects changing social values and norms that businesses must adapt to. Situation (iii) represents the Economic environment — the increase in interest rates by banks is an economic factor that directly affects consumers' financial commitments such as EMIs. Rising interest rates increase the cost of borrowing and affect purchasing power. Situation (iv) represents the Legal environment — printing 'Mother's milk is best for babies' on baby food packaging is a legal obligation under food labelling laws designed to protect consumer interests and ensure ethical business practices.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following features of planning :
(i) Planning focuses on achieving objectives.
(ii) Planning is pervasive.

key_points: Planning focuses on achieving objectives: all planning activity is directed towards achieving specified goals.
Planning is pervasive: planning is required at all levels of management and in all departments.

sub_questions.solution: Planning focuses on achieving objectives means that planning is always goal-oriented. Every plan is formulated with a specific purpose or objective in mind, whether it is increasing sales, reducing costs, or expanding into new markets. Without objectives, planning becomes meaningless because there would be no direction for action. All activities in the planning process — setting premises, identifying alternatives, evaluating alternatives, and selecting the best course — are aimed at achieving the predetermined objectives. Planning is pervasive means that planning is not confined to top management alone; it is required at every level of management and in every department of the organisation. The Managing Director plans the overall corporate strategy, middle managers plan for their respective departments, and supervisors plan day-to-day activities. Thus, planning permeates the entire organisation from top to bottom.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following points of the importance of planning :
(i) Planning provides directions.
(ii) Planning promotes innovative ideas.

key_points: Planning provides direction: it tells employees what to do and how to do it, unifying efforts towards organisational goals.
Planning promotes innovative ideas: it requires managers to think ahead and come up with creative solutions to anticipated problems.

sub_questions.solution: Planning provides directions means that planning tells managers and employees what to do, when to do it, and how to do it. By establishing clear objectives and laying out the steps to achieve them, planning gives a definite direction to all organisational activities. Without planning, actions would be random and uncoordinated, leading to chaos. Planning ensures that all individuals and departments move in the same direction towards the common organisational goals, thereby unifying efforts and resources. Planning promotes innovative ideas means that planning requires managers to think creatively about the future. Since planning involves anticipating future challenges and opportunities, it encourages managers to come up with new and better ways of doing things. Innovative thinking is essential during the planning process because managers must evaluate multiple alternatives and choose the most effective course of action. This creative problem-solving fosters a culture of innovation within the organisation.

questions.solution: This is an either/or question. Answer sub-part (a) OR sub-part (b).

अपने घरों के लिए जनता की जबरदस्त प्रतिक्रिया को देखते हुए अरुण ने, जो एक अग्रणी निर्माणी कंपनी 'लग्सरी एट होम' का मालिक है, भारत के आठ और शहरों में अपनी नई परियोजना को शुरूआरंभ करने का निर्णय लिया। इस निर्णय में ₹ 150 करोड़ की अतिरिक्त पूँजी विनिवेशित करने की आवश्यकता होगी। श्याम ने, जो कि वित्त प्रबंधक है, अरुण को सलाह दी कि सारी राशि समता द्वारा एकत्रित करने की अपेक्षा यदि यह राशि 40% समता एवं 60% ऋण के विवेकपूर्ण मिश्रण के द्वारा एकत्रित की जाए तो अधिक अच्छा होगा।
श्याम ने समझाया कि, चूँकि कंपनी पर्याप्त लाभ अर्जित कर रही है, वह प्रति अंश आय को अधिकतम करने के लिए समता पर व्यापार का लाभ भी उठा सकते हैं। उसने यह भी सुझाव दिया कि इस ऋण को वित्तीय संस्था से ऋण के माध्यम से एकत्रित करना अच्छा होगा क्योंकि इसमें लागत कम आएगी। उसने पुन: जोड़ा कि ऋण से कंपनी पर प्रबंधन का नियंत्रण भी कम नहीं होगा इसलिए भी यह लाभदायक है।
श्याम के सुझावों पर उचित चिंतन करने के बाद अरुण सहमत हो गया।
(i) श्याम द्वारा अरुण को सुझाई गई वित्तीय प्रबंध की अवधारणा का उल्लेख कीजिए।
(ii) उपर्युक्त (i) में पहचानी गई अवधारणा को प्रभावित करने वाले किन्हीं तीन घटकों का उल्लेख कीजिए जिनकी चर्चा श्याम द्वारा उपर्युक्त अनुच्छेद में की गई है।
questions.text_english:
After seeing an overwhelming response from people for their homes, Arun, the owner of a leading construction company 'Luxury At Home' decided to launch new projects in eight more cities across India. This decision would require additional investment of ₹ 150 crores. Shyam, the finance manager advised Arun that instead of raising the entire amount through equity, it would be better to raise funds with a judicious mix of 40% equity and 60% debt.
Shyam explained that since the company was earning sufficient profits, they could also take advantage of trading on equity to maximise earning per share. He also suggested that raising this debt through a loan from a financial institution would be better as this would involve a lower cost. He further added that debt was also beneficial as it would not dilute the management's holding in the company.
After giving due thought, Arun agreed to Shyam's suggestions.
(i) State the concept of financial management suggested by Shyam to Arun.
(ii) State any three factors discussed by Shyam in the above paragraph, affecting the concept identified in (i) above.

key_points: (i) Capital Structure (the concept of deciding the optimal mix of debt and equity).

(ii) Three factors: (a) Trading on equity — using debt to increase earnings per share since the company is profitable; (b) Cost of debt — loan from financial institution is cheaper than equity; (c) Control — debt does not dilute management's control over the company.

questions.solution: The concept of financial management suggested by Shyam to Arun is Capital Structure — the decision about the optimal mix of debt and equity to finance the company's operations and expansion. Shyam recommended a mix of 40% equity and 60% debt rather than raising all funds through equity. Three factors affecting this capital structure decision, as discussed by Shyam, are as follows. First, trading on equity (leverage) — since the company is earning sufficient profits, using debt allows it to magnify the earnings per share for equity shareholders, which is the benefit of trading on equity. Second, cost of capital — Shyam suggested raising debt from a financial institution because debt is cheaper than equity (interest is tax-deductible), which reduces the overall cost of capital. Third, control — raising funds through debt does not dilute the ownership or management control of existing shareholders, whereas issuing new equity would reduce the existing shareholders' proportionate control. Hence, debt is preferred to maintain management control.

sub_questions.text_english:
'Successful organisations do not achieve their goals by chance, but by following a deliberate process called management.'
In the light of this statement, explain any four points of the importance of management.

key_points: Management helps in achieving group goals.
Management increases efficiency.
Management creates a dynamic organisation.
Management helps in achieving personal objectives.
Management helps in the development of society.

sub_questions.solution: Management is vital for the success of any organisation, as highlighted by the given statement. Four important points are as follows. First, achievement of group goals — management integrates the efforts of all individuals in an organisation and directs them towards the common goals. Without management, individuals would work in different directions, making it impossible to achieve shared objectives. Second, increases efficiency — management ensures that resources such as men, machines, money, and materials are used optimally, reducing wastage and increasing productivity. Efficient use of resources lowers costs and improves the quality of output. Third, creates a dynamic organisation — management helps organisations adapt to a constantly changing environment. By planning ahead and responding to change, management ensures that the organisation remains competitive and relevant. Fourth, helps in achieving personal objectives — good management motivates employees by linking their personal goals with organisational goals. Through fair compensation, promotions, and recognition, employees feel valued and strive to give their best, achieving both personal and organisational success simultaneously.

sub_questions.text_english:
'Coordination is the process by which a manager synchronises the activities of different departments towards the achievement of common goals.'
In the light of this statement, explain any four features of coordination.

key_points: Coordination integrates group efforts.
Coordination ensures unity of action.
Coordination is a continuous process.
Coordination is an all-pervasive function.
Coordination is the responsibility of every manager.

sub_questions.solution: Coordination is a fundamental feature of management. Four key features are as follows. First, coordination integrates group efforts — all activities in an organisation are interdependent. Coordination ensures that the efforts of all individuals and departments are brought together in a unified manner to achieve common goals. Without coordination, departments would work in isolation and conflict. Second, coordination ensures unity of action — coordination binds the activities of various departments into a harmonious whole. Just as in a symphony orchestra where each musician plays a different instrument but all follow the conductor, coordination ensures that all parts of the organisation work in unison. Third, coordination is a continuous process — it is not a one-time activity. Coordination must be maintained continuously throughout the existence of the organisation because new problems and conflicts keep arising that require ongoing managerial attention. Fourth, coordination is pervasive — it is required at all levels and in all departments of the organisation. Top management coordinates broad strategic activities, middle management coordinates inter-departmental activities, and supervisors coordinate day-to-day operations. It is thus an all-pervasive function.

questions.solution: This is an either/or question. Answer sub-part (a) OR sub-part (b).

questions.text_english:
Ankita was the Managing Director at 'Tech Smart', an IT company. She was facing problems in retaining the employees in the company. While discussing this problem with her friend, Prachi, who had recently completed her MBA in Human Resource Management, she shared that employees in her company are not motivated enough even though the company was offering them good salaries and stability of income.
Prachi explained to Ankita that all the needs of the employees are not satisfied by money alone. Psychological, social and emotional factors also play an important role in providing motivation.
Explain any four such incentives which may help the company in retaining its employees and provide motivation as suggested by Prachi.

key_points: Non-financial incentives: Status, Job security, Job enrichment, Employee recognition, Participation in management, Opportunities for advancement.

questions.solution: Since Prachi suggested that psychological, social, and emotional factors are important for motivation, the following four non-financial incentives would help Tech Smart in retaining employees. First, status — conferring a high job title, a private cabin, or a prestigious designation satisfies an employee's ego and psychological need for recognition, thereby increasing commitment to the organisation. Second, job enrichment — designing jobs to include more challenging tasks, greater responsibility, and opportunities for skill development makes work meaningful and intrinsically motivating. Employees who find their work stimulating are less likely to leave. Third, employee recognition — acknowledging employees' contributions through awards, certificates, or public appreciation fulfils their social and emotional need for appreciation and belonging. Recognition without monetary reward can be a powerful motivator. Fourth, participation in management — involving employees in decision-making processes makes them feel valued and respected. When employees have a voice in organisational decisions, they feel a sense of ownership and loyalty, which significantly improves retention.

स्वस्थ खाद्य उत्पादों की बढ़ती हुई माँग के कारण, मेघा ने एक प्रतिष्ठित संस्थान से पाक-पाठ्यक्रम पूरा करने के बाद 'गुड बेकर्स' का शुभारंभ किया। उसका मुख्य केन्द्र-बिन्दु ग्राहकों की आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करना था। अत:, उसने मोटे अनाज (मिलेट्स) से बने, कृत्रिम परिरक्षकों के बिना स्वस्थ बिस्कुट तथा केक उत्पादित करने का निर्णय लिया।

उपर्युक्त अनुच्छेद में चर्चित विपणन मिश्र के विभिन्न घटकों को समझाइए।
questions.text_english:
Due to the increasing demand for healthy food products, Megha launched 'Good Bakers' after completing a culinary course at a reputed institute. Her main focus was on meeting customers' needs. So, she decided to manufacture healthy biscuits and cakes made from millets, without any artificial preservatives.
To capture a wider market and to offer her products, she not only planned to directly take orders from the customers, but also through retailers who would sell them to end consumers. This would ensure that the products are available at a place where the customers would like to buy them. In addition, Megha decided to offer free samples of her cakes and biscuits at stalls in prominent markets and shopping malls. This would increase visibility and attract potential buyers.
Explain the various components of marketing mix discussed in the above paragraph.

key_points: Product: Healthy biscuits and cakes made from millets without artificial preservatives — product design aligned with customer needs.
Place (Distribution): Direct selling and through retailers — ensuring availability at customer-preferred locations.
Promotion: Offering free samples at stalls in markets and malls — a sales promotion technique to increase visibility.
Price: Not explicitly mentioned but the quality-focused product implies premium positioning.

questions.solution: The marketing mix consists of the 4 Ps — Product, Price, Place, and Promotion. The paragraph discusses three of these components. First, Product — Megha's main focus was on meeting customers' needs. She decided to manufacture healthy biscuits and cakes made from millets without artificial preservatives. This reflects the product component of the marketing mix, where the product is designed to satisfy the target customers' requirement for healthy, natural food options. Second, Place (Distribution) — to ensure that products are available where customers want to buy them, Megha planned both direct selling (taking orders from customers directly) and indirect selling through retailers who would sell to end consumers. This represents the place component — the channel through which the product reaches the final consumer. Third, Promotion — Megha decided to offer free samples of her cakes and biscuits at stalls in prominent markets and shopping malls. Distributing free samples is a sales promotion technique that increases product visibility, encourages trial, and attracts potential buyers. This constitutes the promotion component of the marketing mix.

sub_questions.text_english:
'Organisation's decision to opt for Functional Structure or Divisional Structure will vary with the nature and type of activities performed by it.'
Differentiate between 'Functional Structure' and 'Divisional Structure' on the basis of the following :
(i) Formation
(ii) Specialisation
(iii) Responsibility
(iv) Cost
(v) Managerial development
(vi) Coordination

key_points: Formation: Functional — based on functions (Marketing, Finance, HR); Divisional — based on products/divisions.
Specialisation: Functional — functional specialists; Divisional — managers develop overall management skills.
Responsibility: Functional — difficult to fix responsibility for overall results; Divisional — easy to fix responsibility for divisional performance.
Cost: Functional — economical due to no duplication; Divisional — expensive due to duplication of activities.
Managerial development: Functional — limited; Divisional — promotes managerial development.
Coordination: Functional — difficult between departments; Divisional — easy within division.

sub_questions.solution: Functional Structure and Divisional Structure differ as follows on six bases. Regarding Formation, functional structure is formed by grouping all activities of similar nature (e.g., Marketing, Finance, Production) into departments, while divisional structure is formed by grouping activities based on different products or product lines (e.g., Electronics Division, Clothing Division). Regarding Specialisation, functional structure promotes functional specialisation as each department focuses on one function, whereas divisional structure promotes overall managerial skills since each division handles all functions related to its product. Regarding Responsibility, in functional structure it is difficult to fix accountability for the overall performance of the organisation because all departments contribute to each product, whereas in divisional structure it is easy to fix responsibility as each division manager is accountable for divisional profits and losses. Regarding Cost, functional structure is more economical as there is no duplication of activities, while divisional structure is more expensive because each division maintains its own departments, leading to duplication. Regarding Managerial development, functional structure provides limited scope for overall management development due to functional specialisation, whereas divisional structure provides greater scope for developing all-round managers. Regarding Coordination, coordination across functions in functional structure is difficult due to inter-departmental conflicts, while within a division in divisional structure, coordination is easier because all related functions are under one head.

sub_questions.text_english:
'Decentralisation is a philosophy that implies selective dispersal of authority because it propagates the belief that people are competent, capable and resourceful.'
In the light of this statement, explain any four points that highlight the importance of Decentralisation.

key_points: Develops initiative among subordinates.
Develops managerial talent for the future.
Quick decision-making.
Relieves top management of excessive workload.
Motivates employees by giving them a sense of responsibility.

sub_questions.solution: Decentralisation is important for any growing organisation for the following four reasons. First, it develops initiative among subordinates — when authority is delegated to lower levels, employees are encouraged to think independently and take decisions on their own. This cultivates initiative, confidence, and a sense of responsibility among junior managers and workers. Second, it develops managerial talent for the future — by allowing lower-level managers to handle significant responsibilities, decentralisation provides them with practical experience in decision-making and management. This prepares them for higher positions in the future and ensures a ready pool of capable managers. Third, it facilitates quick decision-making — in a decentralised organisation, decisions are made at the point where the problem arises rather than being referred upwards through the hierarchy. This speeds up the decision-making process and makes the organisation more responsive to market changes. Fourth, it relieves top management of excessive work — decentralisation frees top managers from routine operational decisions, allowing them to focus on strategic planning, policy formulation, and long-term goals. This improves the quality of decisions at the top level and makes the organisation more effective overall.

questions.solution: This is an either/or question. Answer sub-part (a) OR sub-part (b).
